text:
{collection}.{field}: {type_id} names no plugin of the model.
A plugin's field type needs its namespace in plugins.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a plugin field type's namespace is not in the model's plugins. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
